User Story:
As a pipeline developer, I want to seamlessly upgrade a dataset instance to the latest version of the code after the pipeline has been established, ensuring that the dataset benefits from the latest features and improvements.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The upgrade process must be completed without any downtime, maintaining continuous access to the dataset.

- Track the time taken for the upgrade to ensure it completes within the specified 10-minute window.
